statement: MUST: The site header MUST offer at most six sections plus a search field: Places; Explore (Map, Graph explorer, Search, Disagreements); Organizations; Watch; Sources & data (Sources, Evidence, Downloads & API, Releases & changes, Status); About (About & how it works, How to read SIG, Glossary, Methodology, How sure is SIG?, Editorial standards, Corrections, Open questions, Dispute). A section or menu item MUST render only when its target route exists in the release being served.
rationale: Today 15 unmarked header links and no search (K14 NEW-9); capability binding keeps the nav from promising pages the release lacks (DR-K14-05); one IA for every K row.
acceptance_test: DOM test: <=6 top-level items, search field present, aria-current on the active section; build a fixture release without /watch/ and assert the Watch item is absent; crawl of every header and menu link returns 200.

statement: MUST: Every route pattern in the page-type registry MUST declare its page type, owner ticket, data-contract id(s) and its no-JS equivalent; the build MUST fail on an unclassified built route or a pattern missing any field.
rationale: K0 makes the registry the site map's backbone (K0 8, K13 row); owner and contract fields make the IA auditable and fail closed (K0 NEW-4).
acceptance_test: Registry schema test; a planted unclassified page and a planted pattern without owner each fail the astro:build:done hook.

statement: MUST: Every rendered mention of an entity, place, source, evidence artifact, research task, watch item or release MUST be a link to that object's page using the shared label or handle, or a typed absence. UUIDs, connector keys and registry ids MUST appear only inside Identifiers / Technical details blocks.
rationale: The operator's U-003.2/.11 complaint (UUIDs) and K12b's finding that nothing leads anywhere (NEW-21); generalises K2 SIG-UI-D20, K5 SIG-DSRC-D02 and K11 SIG-RQ-D01 across all page types.
acceptance_test: Crawl of dist: every mention element of these kinds is an <a> resolving 200; 0 text nodes matching the UUID or '^[a-z_]+:[^ ]+:' key patterns in h1-h3, a, td, li, SVG text outside identifier blocks.

statement: MUST: From every material figure on every page type, the reader MUST reach the claim anchor, record list or evidence artifact behind it in at most two actions, with JavaScript on and off, or see the stated reason why it cannot.
rationale: SIG's defining standard and the journalist's core task (U-005; C6 DR-C6-18/19; D3 J1); J3 TX-09 enforces pointers but not the hop count on every page type.
acceptance_test: Crawl every <Figure> on one page of each type; follow its links with JS off: <=2 hops to a /r/ claim anchor, record list or /evidence/ page (or a reason element); repeat with JS on.

statement: MUST: Each page type MUST carry the sideways links of the K13 matrix (2.4): dossier to its map, graph, scoped search, watch, open questions, sources ledger, organizations and parent/child places; entity to its places, relationships, graph view, sources and tasks; source to its dossiers, entities, runs, captures, downloads and upstream; evidence to its claims, source and upstream; task and watch item to their subject, place and evidence.
rationale: K14 5.2 'every page links sideways'; K12b's dead ends; the operator's 'traversable' ask.
acceptance_test: Template test per page type asserting each required link target is present or replaced by a typed absence.

statement: MUST: Every source page and evidence-artifact page MUST show at least one upstream link (S-6 gated) or a named absence, and every dossier and the About page MUST carry a neutral 'Other public resources' block that excludes avoidance routing and plate lookups.
rationale: The site has zero outbound links (K12b NEW-21); U-003.9 asks for 'ground truth' links; D3 Q4.
acceptance_test: Crawl: 100% of /sources/<id>/ and /evidence/artifact/* pages contain an http(s) upstream link or an absence token; dossier template test for the block; lint for plate-lookup or avoidance domains.

statement: MUST: Place-scoped routes MUST use the K4 display-slug path (for example usa/tx/harris-county-48201) as path segments, handles MUST use the dash-joined place token, and no new route may carry a bare two-letter jurisdiction code.
rationale: K2, K7, K8 and K11 each proposed a place segment; one form keeps links predictable and avoids the ID/MN collisions (K4).
acceptance_test: Regex over every built route: place segments match the registry's display paths; bare two-letter codes occur only on redirect stubs.

statement: MUST: Every URL SIG has published (dossier slugs, entity keys, task/watch/evidence handles, /data-freshness/**, /network/, /task/<uuid>/, /id/<type>/<uuid>, /evidence/<id>/) MUST resolve through one generated redirect include with 301/300/410 semantics and static stubs as fallback; no historical URL may return 404 or come to denote a different object.
rationale: Four rows each designed a redirect mechanism (K2, K4, K9, K11); one generator (JUR-05) avoids conflicting includes.
acceptance_test: G3 V5 extension over the union of every history file (slug history, handles_history, jurisdiction_slug_history, fixed legacy list): 0 x 404, each target matches its history row.

statement: MUST: sig.workspace-state/2 MUST be defined by one parameter registry: common v, release, view, q, type (result type), kind (entity type), jurisdiction (a filter including descendants), frame and bbox (framing only, canonicalised to at), technology, vendor, operator, source, collection, location, status (epistemic status), seen (when SIG observed it), dated (the world date of the fact), currency, focus, page, sort, dir, cursor, within; map at, layers, basemap; graph overview, hops, edge, expand, path. Every v=1 URL MUST keep resolving.
rationale: K0, K1, K2 and K3 each extended the contract differently (K1 seen/bbox, K2 years/path/currency, K3 type/within/cursor); K14 forbids conflating world and belief time.
acceptance_test: Schema test; round-trip unit tests per surface; v=1 fixture links resolve to the same state; K1's kind=site and K2's years= rejected by the schema with a migration note.

statement: MUST: A surface that receives a workspace-state parameter it cannot apply MUST display a visible notice naming that parameter and MUST NOT present unfiltered results as filtered.
rationale: All three islands parse jurisdiction/source/location/technology and silently ignore them (K6 NEW-1); every dossier Explore link depends on this.
acceptance_test: Conformance e2e matrix (surface x common facet): each cell either applies the facet (result subset check) or renders the notice.

statement: MUST: One machine-readable legend lexicon MUST define every symbol, fill, line pattern, colour role and short label, and every template, SVG builder and map style MUST read it. On any page each encoding MUST have one meaning: hollow = exactly one source (points and areas only, never network figures); line pattern = access kind only (configured solid, stated dashed, observed double); currency = ink weight plus a word or date, never a pattern; raspberry = contested or unresolved only; amber = provisional only; the hatch = absence only.
rationale: 'Hollow' and 'dashed' each carried two meanings across K1, K2, K6 and K14 (K6 NEW-2); K14 NEW-2 showed the contested colour doing four jobs.
acceptance_test: Lexicon unit tests; template and style grep for symbol classes or colours not in the lexicon; greyscale print check of a dossier carrying Figure 1 and a network figure.

statement: MUST: The record lifecycle state 'Candidate' and the epistemic label 'Provisional' (output of a method not yet independently evaluated) MUST be distinct words, symbols and filter values on every surface.
rationale: K1 used 'provisional (candidate)' as a map status while K14/L3 reserve Provisional (amber) for unevaluated methods.
acceptance_test: Copy lint: no 'provisional' in lifecycle contexts; map status facet values = corroborated, single source, contested, candidate.

statement: MUST: The UI MUST call observation-level rows 'records' and MUST say 'camera sites' or 'listed cameras' only for de-duplicated counts, which appear only once L3 CONF-07b publishes them and then as an interval beside the record count.
rationale: No cross-source de-duplication reaches any published row (L1 NEW-8; L2: dossier counts inflated up to 2.25x); K1 wrote 'sites' for records; SIG-RECON-058.
acceptance_test: Copy lint over built HTML for the controlled vocabulary; fixture before and after CONF-07b renders the right form.

statement: MUST: The corroborated (filled) vs single-source (hollow) encoding MUST count independent lineages; until lineage is declared (L3 CONF-04/CONF-07b) the legend MUST say '2+ source records; republications not yet collapsed'.
rationale: Mirrors are not independent (P15; K2 H-11); L1 NEW-4: independence is never declared, so two DeFlock/OSM republishes would read as corroboration.
acceptance_test: Fixture with a declared mirror pair renders hollow; pre-CONF-04 build renders the interim legend text.

statement: SHOULD: The map SHOULD draw records in one data hue and convey technology by facet, legend, list and text code; a categorical colour key SHOULD wait until F5 PKG-07 typing is live and a K14 amendment validates it.
rationale: K1 proposed <=8 categorical colours; K14 reserves saturated hues and uses one hue plus shape; 77% of 'traffic_camera' rows are mistyped today (L2 NEW-6), so a colour key would mislead.
acceptance_test: Style lint: the site layers use <=1 data hue; technology legend lists counts and text codes.

statement: MUST: Every build-time SVG (maps, locators, entity egos, overview graphs, dossier network figures, charts) MUST come from one static figure kit that emits byte-deterministic SVG with no script, no event attributes and no external references; inline figures MUST be styled by the page stylesheet's classes, and standalone figure files MUST be served under a dedicated no-script response policy.
rationale: Ownership of the SVG generators was circular across K1/K2/K4/K5/K6 (K6 NEW-3) and K0's strict CSP conflicted with K14's self-styled standalone SVGs (K6 NEW-4).
acceptance_test: Build twice: identical bytes; SVG lint for script, on*, external href; CSP e2e on inline and standalone figures with 0 violations.

statement: MUST: Entity labels, entity URL keys (7-character hash) and the T/M/W/E handles (4+ character hash) MUST come from one module sharing slug and hash primitives and the Part VIII person-name screen; search shards, map tiles, graph files, watch/evidence/task titles and the API MUST read its outputs.
rationale: K2 and K11 each defined a slug grammar and hash length; K3, K7 and K8 needed labels; one module prevents drift (K0 R-3).
acceptance_test: Parity test over a 500-entity stratified sample across page, record, overview, shard, tile and API; handle golden tests including collision extension and the person-name fallback.

statement: MUST: Until the release record tree /r/<pub>/ is publicly exposed (G2 ACT-24), links to an individual site record MUST target its row in the dossier sites list (/dossier/<path>/sites/...#<key>); afterwards they MUST target the T0 record. No site link may return 404.
rationale: K1/K3 link records at /r/, K12b I-16 proposed /site/<id>/, and the Round-10 archive stays dark until HG-11 (C6 PG-7).
acceptance_test: Crawl of map lists, search cards and entity pages before and after exposure: 0 x 404 site links; targets match the rule.

statement: MUST: Every dossier level MUST be rendered by one template in SIG-UI-010 order with these sections, each a value or a typed empty state: header strip (K4 row fields), At a glance with Figure 1 and locator, Explore bar, deployed/cost/access/policy figures, Where the hardware is (sites list), Where this comes from (K5), Next decisions (K7), What we don't know (with K11 links), Other public resources, How we know this (dossier scope).
rationale: Five rows add sections to the dossier; one owner (VIZ-02) keeps order, budgets and print coherent.
acceptance_test: Template test over country, state, county and place fixtures; section presence and typed-empty checks; T1 budgets.

statement: MUST: /entity/ MUST list the published entity types with counts and link a paginated A-Z list per type; every entity count MUST carry the entity-resolution disclosure.
rationale: K14's 'Organizations' nav section needs a landing page; K2 defined entity pages but no index.
acceptance_test: Route test; counts equal the label registry per type; the disclosure text is present.

statement: MUST: SIG MUST publish a disagreements browser listing every published contradiction record with both sides, sources and dates, kept apart from within-source coordinate conflicts and declared-vs-located disagreements, each labelled by kind; the phrase 'kept visible' MUST appear only where the page links them.
rationale: 'Contradictions kept visible' is shown nowhere (K12b NEW-17); 5,278 'conflicted' subjects are identity defects, not disagreements (L2 NEW-1); contradiction recall is ~0 until L3 CONF-05.
acceptance_test: Counts per kind equal the release recompute; each row links both sides; copy lint for 'kept visible'.

statement: MUST: SIG MUST publish a changes page and Atom feeds per place and per source generated from release diffs, separating 'SIG's records changed' from 'the source reports a change in the world', dated by release activation and world dates, never by version-control dates.
rationale: D3 J5 ('what changed since the last release?'); no change surface exists and /v1/changes is empty (K12b NEW-19).
acceptance_test: Two fixture releases: page and feeds list the expected adds/removes/changes; feeds validate; no git-derived date appears.

statement: MUST: The header typeahead, /search/, scoped forms, the map place search and the explorer's search-to-node MUST use the same release-pinned index and static shards; no surface may keep its own entity or place index, call the live spine, or send keystrokes to a server.
rationale: K1, K2, K3 and K4 each proposed a search entry; K12b's 'expose /v1/search' shortcut conflicts with K0 I-10.
acceptance_test: Network assertion in e2e: only same-origin shard GETs while typing; results for B01-B08 identical across entry points.

statement: MUST: A place name typed into any search entry (header, home hero, dossier index, map) MUST resolve through the one gazetteer (the K4 registry plus the city layer) to the same top result, showing homonyms with their parents.
rationale: 'Canberra' -> 0 today; four entry points must not disagree (C2 P6-T1; K3 SIG-SRCH-D04).
acceptance_test: Benchmark queries B01-B08 and 'Oklahoma City' through each entry point return the same top-1 place.

statement: MUST: Every internal link in new or changed templates MUST be built with the base-path helper so that a snapshot build under /s/<pub>/ keeps its links inside the snapshot.
rationale: The web code has 85 root-absolute path sites (G3 NEW-6); every Round-11 page added without the helper enlarges TX-13b's refactor.
acceptance_test: G3 V5 containment check on a snapshot build of every new template.

statement: MUST: Public pages MUST read only release-pinned data (static release files, PMTiles, release-namespaced API routes); any live-spine route shown to readers MUST be labelled 'live, not a citation'.
rationale: K0 I-10 and G3 REL-05; citation stability (U-005).
acceptance_test: e2e network assertion: no fetch to /v1/ outside /v1/releases/; label present where live routes are shown.

statement: MUST: Each operator ask U-003.1 to U-003.11 MUST have a named live acceptance check (K13 5.1) that passes on the promoted release before announcement, recorded as agent-verified with evidence, never as user-tested.
rationale: The operator asked that every ask be systematically logged and satisfied (U-003); P4/P5.
acceptance_test: CAP-01 readout lists all 11 asks plus U-003.G with pass/fail, URL, release id and evidence file.

statement: MUST: D3's 13 journeys (A1-A4, J1-J5, O1-O4) MUST pass on the promoted release at 390 px and 1440 px, with JavaScript on and, where the journey allows, off, within their budgets and with zero wrong-conclusion risk; results recorded agent-verified plus the operator's walkthrough.
rationale: D3 2 makes the journeys the Round-11 acceptance test and the co-primary audiences equal (U-002, U-005).
acceptance_test: CAP-01 per-journey record: steps, URLs, timings, pass criteria; operator walkthrough notes captured verbatim.

statement: MUST: Open research questions MUST be reachable in one action from every typed-absence chip that has a task and from each dossier's 'What we don't know' section; the queue hub MUST be linked from About and from the organizer start-here path.
rationale: U-003.11: the queue must be usable; K14 places it under About, so discoverability must come from the absences it closes.
acceptance_test: Crawl: every absence chip with a task id links a 200 /task/ page; hub linked from both entry points.

statement: MUST: Where the publication gate withholds organisations or relationships, surfaces MUST say 'some relationships are not shown pending publication review' without naming or counting Part VIII withholdings.
rationale: All 969 referenced organisations are review-flagged (K2 NEW-1); until D-K2-1 acts, graphs and entity pages must not look complete.
acceptance_test: Fixture with a withheld organisation: notice rendered, no counts of Part VIII withholdings, no node or label.

statement: MUST: Each acceptance ticket with a live stage MUST read the billing export and report the UX serving cost (map sessions, tiles, search queries, downloads egress) against the $300/month ceiling; a design change projected to exceed it MUST wait for the operator's explicit go.
rationale: U-008; K0 5.3, K1 2.4 and K3 5.7 estimate costs that must be measured live.
acceptance_test: MAP-07, SRCH-07 and CAP-01 readouts contain the cost table with dates from the billing export.

statement: SHOULD: In Round 11, machine-readable metadata (DCAT, PROV) SHOULD ship as linked files, not inline JSON-LD, although the page-type registry classifies application/ld+json as data.
rationale: J3 D-J3-7 (linked files only) and K0 D-K0-5 (JSON-LD permitted as data) differ; linked files satisfy both now.
acceptance_test: e2e: no inline application/ld+json in T1 pages; linked metadata files parse.

statement: MUST: Record pages, the claim viewer, entity relationship rows, graph edge panels and the map selection panel MUST render claim provenance through one <ProvenancePanel> data contract with the same fields and binding-state wording.
rationale: J3 5.2, K2 edge panel, K8 claim viewer and K1 panel each described provenance; one contract prevents divergent claims about evidence (C4 NEW-2 lesson).
acceptance_test: Render one sampled claim in each surface: field set and binding-state text identical.

statement: MUST: Every number in page main content MUST be rendered by the one <Figure> component, and each page MUST have one figures[] registry whose ids are unique and resolve to breakdowns.
rationale: J3 TX-09, K5 figures[], K6 fig-* ids and K14's Figure visual are one component (K12b NEW-14: tiles without paths).
acceptance_test: Build check: numerals in main outside <Figure> fail for the named page classes; duplicate figure ids fail.

statement: MUST: The T2 set MUST stay exactly {map, graph explorer, search}; watch, evidence, research-queue, sources and dossier enhancements MUST use T1 kit elements within T1 budgets, and a new T2 surface MUST need an amendment to the page-type ADR.
rationale: K7, K8, K11 and K5 each proposed an 'enhanced island'; K0 4.2 decides no fourth T2.
acceptance_test: Registry test: T2 patterns = /map/, /explore/, /search/ (and their /s/<pub>/ copies).

statement: MUST: Every typed empty state MUST follow the five-part pattern (kind, what is missing and why, what exists nearby, what you can do, when it may change) and MUST name the actual cause class; no surface may call a pipeline or publication gap a research gap.
rationale: K7 NEW-6/K8: /watch/ and /evidence/ blame a 'research gap'; K14 6.4 defines the pattern.
acceptance_test: Component test per EmptySurface kind; copy lint for 'research gap' outside research-queue contexts.

statement: MUST: Release pages MUST NOT show values that depend on the reader's current time (next run, current freshness verdict, status-lane counts); those appear only under /status/** labelled with the status clock.
rationale: Two clocks confuse readers (J3 T-7, K9 C-4, G3 RM-7).
acceptance_test: Crawl: no 'next run' or status-lane field under release routes; /status/ pages carry the status time.

statement: MUST: Historical and undated relationships and facts MUST be marked as such and excluded from present-tense text on every surface that shows them (map panel, search cards, dossier figures, entity pages, graph panels, watch items).
rationale: K2 H-3 covers entity pages and graphs; the same 2016-17 EFF edges surface on dossiers, search and the map.
acceptance_test: Copy lint and DOM test on the Data Driven fixture across all six surfaces.

statement: MUST: Adopt K0 SIG-UI-D01..D10 as drafted, with D01 extended by UXR-02 (owner and data-contract fields) and D06 applied to every figure kind through UXR-16.
rationale: K0 is the binding architecture; K13 only adds IA fields.
acceptance_test: The acceptance tests in K0 9, plus UXR-02 and UXR-16.

statement: MUST: Adopt K1 SIG-UI-DM01..DM08 and SIG-GEO-DM10; amend DM09 so colour means only what UXR-11/UXR-15 allow; amend DM06 so a filter that cannot apply greys the cells with a note and no hatch; UI copy says 'records' (UXR-13).
rationale: Reconciles K1 with K14's reserved hues and hatch rule.
acceptance_test: K1 11 acceptance tests plus the K13 lexicon tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt K2 SIG-UI-D20..D34 and SIG-EXPORT-D20/D21; amend D31 so graph URL state uses dated= (not years=) per UXR-09; replace the H-3 symbols 'dash = historical, hollow = undated' with UXR-11 (muted ink plus the word).
rationale: Resolves K6 NEW-2 and the parameter overlap.
acceptance_test: K2 8 acceptance tests plus UXR-09/UXR-11 tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt K3 SIG-SRCH-D01..D14; entity result links MUST use GX-03 keys; type= is the result type and kind= the entity type (UXR-09); K1's /search/?kind=site becomes type=record.
rationale: K3 was written before K2's URL scheme.
acceptance_test: K3 8 acceptance tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt K4 SIG-JUR-D01..D12; the index place form targets /search/?type=place with the A-Z first-letter fallback (UXR-24); no /map/place/ route.
rationale: One place resolver.
acceptance_test: K4 11 acceptance tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt K5 SIG-DSRC-D01..D09; D05's co-location half is rendered by QB-01 from L3 CONF-07b fields; D06's enhancement is the T1 <sig-table> (ENH-01) and chart brushing is deferred.
rationale: Removes the DSRC-04/CONF-07b overlap.
acceptance_test: K5 8 acceptance tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt K6 SIG-UI-DV01..DV12; DV04 is generalised by UXR-10 and DV11 by UXR-11.
rationale: K6's rules become site-wide.
acceptance_test: K6 12 acceptance tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt K7 SIG-WATCH-D01..D10; the enhanced filter is a T1 <sig-table> use (UXR-35), and no watch map ships in Round 11.
rationale: No fourth T2 surface.
acceptance_test: K7 8 acceptance tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt K8 SIG-EVUI-D01..D10; /evidence/<id>/ 301s to /evidence/claim/<id>/ through the one redirect generator (UXR-08).
rationale: One claim-viewer route.
acceptance_test: K8 6 acceptance tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt J3 SIG-TRANSP-D01..D25 as amended by K9 SIG-TRANSP-D26..D34 and K10 SIG-TRANSP-D35..D43 (D01, D02 and D07 superseded or narrowed as K9 10 states; D17 kept as linked-files-only per UXR-32).
rationale: Reconciles J3 with K9/K10's 23 changes (C-1..C-23).
acceptance_test: J3 11, K9 11 and K10 19 acceptance tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt K11 SIG-RQ-D01..D10; handles share GX-01's primitives (UXR-17).
rationale: One identifier module.
acceptance_test: K11 8 acceptance tests.

statement: MUST: Adopt K14 DR-K14-01..22; DR-K14-16's sections are UXR-01's six; DR-K14-09's lexicon is UXR-11's.
rationale: K14 sketched the IA for K13 to finalize.
acceptance_test: K14 8 acceptance checks.

statement: MUST: Adopt L3 SIG-CONF-D01, D05 and D11 as UX requirements: every confidence statement carries its basis class; possible duplicates and count intervals are rendered (QB-01); /quality/ is linked from the Trust and method hub.
rationale: L3 supplies the fields; K13 names where they render.
acceptance_test: L3 7 tests plus QB-01's.
